subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Which canonical fix path should maintainers use for the Control UI `/model list` and `/model status` bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but linked fix PRs are conflicting, closed unmerged, or proof-blocked, so automation should not queue another repair until maintainers choose or clear the canonical branch.

options.title: Land a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Close or supersede stale/conflicting attempts, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

options.title: Refresh an existing PR
options.body: Ask one contributor to rebase and revise their PR so `list` and `status` use the documented flows and include after-fix proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new fix lane until an existing contributor returns with a mergeable, proven update.

recommendation.title: Land a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede stale/conflicting attempts, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history on Control UI model-command handling and can choose whether to refresh, replace, or close the linked PRs.
